mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (request_id, author_id, content) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{authorId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id AS commentId, c.author_id AS authorId, author.name AS authorName, c.content AS content, c.created_at AS createdAt FROM comments c JOIN users author ON c.author_id = author.user_id WHERE c.request_id = #{requestId} ORDER BY c.created_at ASC
